headerDisplay:
Bridges PetLibro smart feeders and water fountains to Apple HomeKit.

**Use a dedicated PetLibro account.** PetLibro allows only one active session per account, so sharing credentials with the mobile app will log one of them out. Create a second account and share your devices with it.

**Polar wet feeder:** the accessory's main switch is the **Lid** — turning it on opens whichever tray is selected, turning it off closes it. `Tray 1/2/3` select the slot.

email.title: PetLibro Email
email.description: Email of the dedicated PetLibro account.

password.title: PetLibro Password
password.description: MD5-hashed before transmission, matching the official app.

country.title: Country Code
country.description: Two-letter country code sent at login. All regions use the US endpoint.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone sent at login, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

portions.title: Portions per Feed (dry feeders)
portions.description: Auger revolutions per tap. Dry feeders only — ignored by the Polar wet feeder, which serves a whole tray.

wetPlate.title: Fallback Tray (Polar wet feeder)
wetPlate.description: Only used when the feeder does not report its current tray position. Normally the lid opens whichever tray is currently selected, and that selection persists, so this rarely applies.

exposeTraySwitches.title: Show a switch per tray (Polar wet feeder)
exposeTraySwitches.description: Adds Tray 1/2/3 switches showing which slot is in position; tap one to rotate to it. Turn off to leave only the Lid control.

enableTrayRotation.title: Show "Rotate Tray" nudge switch (Polar wet feeder)
enableTrayRotation.description: Off by default. Adds a switch that advances the tray one slot without saying which. The per-tray switches do this better by naming the slot you want; this exists only if you prefer a blind "next" nudge.

fountainPollingInterval.title: Fountain Polling Interval (seconds)
fountainPollingInterval.description: How often water level is refreshed for fountains.

debugDeviceDump.title: Log Raw Device List (diagnostics)
debugDeviceDump.description: Logs the raw /device/device/list response at startup. Useful when reporting an unsupported model. Contains device metadata only — no credentials or tokens.

apiEndpoint.title: API Endpoint Override
apiEndpoint.description: Advanced. Leave empty to use https://api.us.petlibro.com.
